# Game Nuke Official

> Official product documentation and release portal for Game Nuke Laniakea Edition, a free Android gaming telemetry and performance utility for Android 11–16.

Canonical website: https://gamenukeofficial.com/
Primary language: English
Current release: v4.1.0-Laniakea
Availability: Free to download and use (no paid subscriptions or in-app purchases)
Supported platform: Android 11–16, ARM64
Developer: Agung Developer (agungofficialdev@gmail.com)
Core access model: No root required for core features; optional elevated workflows support Shizuku or Wireless Debugging on compatible devices.
Performance policy: Actual FPS, frame pacing, latency, and thermal behavior depend on device hardware, OS policies, active game workload, and ambient conditions.

## Overview
Game Nuke unifies real-time Android gaming diagnostics and quick utility controls in a single cockpit without altering game files or installed games:
- Live telemetry: FPS, frame pacing consistency, thermal trend tracking, and available memory overview
- Touch calibration: Multi-stage gesture response and sensitivity tuning profiles
- Network tools: Connection diagnostics and configurable DNS routing options
- Tactical Audio equalizer: Balanced acoustic clarity presets for in-game audio cues
- Floating cockpit: Lightweight overlay telemetry, quick controls, and memory relief tools during gameplay
